---
title: "How to comment"
description: "A two-minute guide to joining the discussion on GGM posts."
---

Comments on GGM run on [giscus](https://giscus.app). Each post's comment thread is stored as a GitHub Discussion, so you will need a free [GitHub account](https://github.com/signup) to comment. You do not need an account to read comments.

**To comment:**

1. Scroll to the bottom of any post.
2. Click **Sign in with GitHub** and authorize giscus. This is a one-time step. It lets giscus post comments under your name and nothing else.
3. Type your comment and click **Comment**.

**Good to know:**

- Comments support Markdown: `*italics*`, `**bold**`, `[links](https://example.org)`, `> quotes`, and code blocks. Use the **Preview** tab to check formatting before posting.
- Click **Reply** under a comment to reply in its thread, or use the emoji reactions to respond.
- To edit or delete a comment, open the thread on GitHub using the link in the comment box.
- If you'd rather not authorize the app, follow the link to the post's Discussion and comment directly on GitHub.

We welcome disagreement. Please keep it collegial and about the ideas, not the people. Comments that aren't may be removed.
